guidance.bestFor: A heading with a muted subtitle, set off from a muted paragraph of body copy by one full width rule

whenNotToUse.when: A break that carries a short caption in the middle of the rule

guidance.bestFor: A single line of 3 one word labels, Blog, Docs and Source, split by 2 rules as tall as the row
agentNotes: Blog, Docs and Source are plain `div` text, not links; wrap each in an anchor with a real target before using the row as navigation

whenNotToUse.when: Side by side entries that each stack a title over a caption

name: c-separator-3
title: Vertical separator groups related menu items.
label: Grouped Menu Items
description: Vertical separator groups related menu items.

guidance.bestFor: Side by side entries, each a medium weight title over a muted caption, split by short rules centered in the row
agentNotes: Keep the forced `self-auto` beside `h-8` on each vertical `Separator`, or its built in `self-stretch` pins the short rule to the top of the row

whenNotToUse.when: One word labels on a single line with rules the full height of the row

name: c-separator-4
title: Horizontal separator between items in a list.
label: List Rows
description: Horizontal separator between items in a list.

guidance.bestFor: A stack of 3 label and value rows with a rule between every row, labels on the left and muted values on the right

whenNotToUse.when: Priced line items with one rule under the heading and another above the total

guidance.bestFor: A lone rule with a small muted caption, or continue with, sitting on a background patch at its middle
agentNotes: The caption `span` hides the rule behind it with `bg-background`; on a card or muted surface swap in that surface color

whenNotToUse.when: A named phase break inside an agent run log or chat transcript
A captioned break between groups of inputs inside a form

guidance.bestFor: A price breakdown of subtotal, discount and tax, ruled off from its heading above and from a medium weight total below
agentNotes: The discount takes `text-success`, a color this item does not install; without a success token in your theme it prints in the default text color
Every amount is a typed string and the total is not summed from the rows; compute each `dd` from your order data

whenNotToUse.when: Label and value rows of equal weight with a rule between every row
